description: Defines the interface TbResponseFormat and its implementations for different response formats (TEXT, JSON, JSON_SCHEMA) used in the rule engine component of Thingsboard AI module.

classes.name: TbResponseFormat
classes.description: Sealed interface representing different response formats for the rule engine, with methods to get type and convert to language chain response format.

classes.name: TbResponseFormatType
classes.description: Enum defining response format types: TEXT, JSON, JSON_SCHEMA.

classes.name: TbTextResponseFormat
classes.description: Implementation of TbResponseFormat for plain text responses.

classes.name: TbJsonResponseFormat
classes.description: Implementation of TbResponseFormat for JSON responses.

classes.name: TbJsonSchemaResponseFormat
classes.description: Implementation of TbResponseFormat for JSON schema responses, includes a schema object.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the specific response format type.

methods.name: toLangChainResponseFormat
methods.description: Converts the response format to the corresponding ResponseFormat object for language chain integration.
